name: MegaTel / MEGA M data center
notes: MegaTel's official page describes colocation/data-center services and lists MEGA M d.o.o. at Rudarska cesta 6, 3320 Velenje. Datacenters.com lists a MEGA M/MegaTel colocation location at the same Velenje address. DataCenterMap confirms MEGA M as a data-center services provider headquartered in Velenje, while also listing MegaTel facilities in Ljubljana, so the Velenje facility location is treated as directory-supported rather than fully primary-source confirmed.
